title: Heal the Inner Child
coreMove: Old wounds stop running the present when you name the script, comfort the younger self, and still choose the next adult action with care instead of excuse or badge.

exampleSpecs.audience: shift lead writing a correction memo
exampleSpecs.stakes: a rushed warning note would punish the wrong problem
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A written memo at the proofing rack shows the protagonist weighing correction against wound work.

exampleSpecs.stakes: one complaint can become either self-punishment or steady service
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two named people respond differently to the same counter complaint and get different outcomes.

exampleSpecs.audience: friends noticing a reaction that outgrows the facts
exampleSpecs.stakes: a small stain can become a full defense of the self
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A peer gives one quotable reframe at the folding table.

exampleSpecs.audience: trainers and learners handling public mistakes
exampleSpecs.stakes: confusion can be treated as shame or as material for learning
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A teaching moment makes the learner's confusion the material.

exampleSpecs.audience: lab staff responsible for fragile records
exampleSpecs.stakes: a routine count can become a replay of older fear
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The same freezer check changes once awareness enters the process.

exampleSpecs.stakes: records can reveal a pattern that memory smooths over
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A quiet review of slips turns on one specific repeated phrase.
